newsitem.title: USA: TV bureau forecasts modest TV ad growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: TV bureau forecasts modest TV ad growth in 1997.

text.p: The Television Bureau of Advertising Thursday forecast modest growth in U.S. television advertising for next year, slowing to an increase of 4 to 5 percent.
The 1996 year, pumped up by political and Olympic advertising, will see robust growth of 7 to 9 percent, the Television Bureau said.

But the next year will show smaller gains without those major advertising events taking place, the Bureau said, although increased outlays from automotive, health care, telecommunications and financial services will make sure that some increase takes place.

Network television advertising will rise 3 to 5 percent, the TVB said, while spot TV will grow 2 to 4 percent and local advertising will rise 3 to 5 percent. Cable television will continue to lead all other sectors, as it has the past two years, with low double digit growth expected.
